items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: they had Benny Goodman, had all the stars, Billy Eckstine, Lena Horne, Georgia Auld, Duke Ellington, Louis Armstrong. I mean the works.

ctx.x: And he had gotten to the point, and it was a hassle that he and Hamp was -- no reason at all, and I wasn't guilty of the fact that what had happened. He had wanted a new horn, and he had gone to Gladys and asked Gladys to pay for the horn. He'd pay her back, and she said, okay,

man, I'll do that.

We were at this time, in 1943, in the Famous Door in New York, and the night that we opened up there, they had Benny Goodman, had all the stars, Billy Eckstine, Lena Horne, Georgia Auld, Duke Ellington, Louis Armstrong. I mean the works. That opening night was terrific. I blew my neck off my horn on Flying Home. I could (inaudible) I blew it off. So my horn was damaged. I had to rubber band it down and everything in the middle of the show. So I couldn't go downstairs and hit no low notes. So I…
Well, what kind of trouble happened?
